title: Pause Before Assuming Hostility
description: When interpreting behavior: - Pause: Ask yourself, "Could this be unintentional or neutral?" - Clarify: If unsure, communicate and seek their perspective. - Reflect: Check if past experiences are influencing your assumptions. Example: If someone doesn’t reply to an email, consider they might be busy, not ignoring you.
